pairs: qui constitutus erat princeps in domo Domini,
the priest who had been appointed leader in the house of the Lord,
And Pashhur struck the prophet Jeremiah,
et misit eum in nervum quod erat in porta Benjamin superiori,
and he sent him to the stocks,
which were at the upper gate of Benjamin at the house of the Lord.
And when it had become light on the next day,
Pashhur led Jeremiah from the stocks.
Non Phassur vocavit Dominus nomen tuum,
“The Lord has not called your name: ‘Pashhur,’
Ecce ego dabo te in pavorem,
I will give you over to fear,
and they will fall by the sword of their enemies,
and your eyes will see it.
et omnem Judam dabo in manum regis Babylonis,
And I will give all of Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon.
And he will lead them away to Babylon,
and he will strike them with the sword.
Et dabo universam substantiam civitatis hujus,
And I will give away the entire substance of this city,
et cunctos thesauros regum Juda dabo in manu inimicorum eorum:
And I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hands of their enemies.
and all the inhabitants of your house,
And you will go to Babylon.
And there you shall be buried,
to whom you have prophesied a lie.”
and I have been led away.
You have been stronger than I,
factus sum in derisum tota die;
I have become a derision all day long;
For I speak now as I have long spoken:
crying out against iniquity and proclaiming devastation.
et factus est mihi sermo Domini in opprobrium, et in derisum tota die.
And the word of the Lord has been made into a reproach against me and a derision, all day long.
I will not call him to mind,
neque loquar ultra in nomine illius:
nor will I speak any longer in his name.
et factus est in corde meo quasi ignis exæstuans,
And my heart became like a raging fire,
And I became weary of continuing to bear it.
For I heard the insults of many,
ab omnibus viris qui erant pacifici mei, et custodientes latus meum:
from all the men who had been at peace with me and who had kept watch by my side.
si quomodo decipiatur, et prævaleamus adversus eum,
‘If only there were some way that he might be deceived,
and we might prevail against him and obtain vengeance from him!’
But the Lord is with me,
those who persecute me will fall,
For they have not understood the everlasting disgrace that will never be wiped away.
O Lord of hosts, the Tester of the just,
qui vides renes et cor, videam,
who sees the temperament and the heart:
I beg you to let me see your vengeance upon them.
For I have revealed my case to you.
quia liberavit animam pauperis de manu malorum.
For he has freed the soul of the poor from the hand of the wicked.
Maledicta dies in qua natus sum!
Cursed is the day on which I was born!
dies in qua peperit me mater mea non sit benedicta!
The day on which my mother gave birth to me: let it not be blessed!
Maledictus vir qui annuntiavit patri meo,
Cursed is the man who announced it to my father,
‘A male child has been born to you,’
causing him to rejoice with gladness.
Sit homo ille ut sunt civitates quæ subvertit Dominus,
Let that man be like the cities that the Lord has overthrown without regret.
et non pœnituit eum: audiat clamorem mane,
Let him hear an outcry in the morning,
and wailing at the time of midday!
qui non me interfecit a vulva,
So let him be, who did not put me to death from the womb,
ut fieret mihi mater mea sepulchrum,
so that my mother would have been my sepulcher,
and her womb would have been my eternal resting place!
Why did I depart from the womb,
so that I would see hardship and sorrow,
et consumerentur in confusione dies mei?
and so that my days would be consumed by trouble?”
